title: DarkCasino
description: RPG based casino featuring 2 casino games you can play to win prizes using diamonds and xp.
body:
# DarkCasino

**DESCRIPTION**

Featuring the casino games from [DarkQuesting](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/darkquesting) and [DarkSpins](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/darkspins) mods but now as a standalone!

_Server side is supported. You can install this on the server and not need to have it installed on the client._

Created by the same authors who made [DarkRPG](https://www.curseforge.com/linkout?remoteUrl=https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/darkrpg) (for a full RPG experience, get the [DarkRPG modpack](https://www.curseforge.com/linkout?remoteUrl=https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/darkrpg) and enjoy quests and rpg gameplay)

 

## Features

(Your vanilla experience will be further enhanced thanks to these features) 

__Creeper Casino__

Stand on a Diamond Block, equip Diamonds in main hand slot and begin to alternate it from main hand to offhand (press F).  The cost is 5 diamonds. Each spin will give you prizes. Some spins may not be so lucky and reward basic prizes so keep trying. Good Luck! 

(consider combining this with the [DarkQuesting](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/darkquesting) or [DarkBindings](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/darkbindings) mods where you can convert rotten flesh into diamonds and be able to play the casino for longer!)

__XP Casino__

Stand on a Diamond Block, equip a Diamond Sword in main hand slot and begin to alternate it from main hand to offhand (press F).  The cost is 3 XP Levels. Each 3 XP Level will spin the XP Wheel and give you a rare prize. Some spins may not be so lucky and reward basic prizes while some may give you enchanting bottles which you can use to get more XP back. The more you spin the more you win!
